INFJ>INTJ.title: You think about people's feelings when you make plans.
INFJ>INTJ.body: When you make a plan, you ask "Will this work?" and also "Will anyone feel bad about this?" Thinking things through on your own and working out the steps ahead of time is something that has never changed. You think it through logically, then you check how the other person will feel, so people quietly rely on you.
INFJ>INTJ.say: "It makes sense. Now it's just how they'll take it."
INFJ>INTJ.do: Before starting a new hobby, you look up how to do it on your own first.
INFJ>INTJ.worry: You know what you want to say, but you spend so long on how to say it that you speak up late. On days you were blunt, the other person's face stays on your mind all night.
INFJ>INTJ.karai: Next year is all planned out, but you still haven't answered about tomorrow's drinks.
INFJ>INTJ.aru: In a meeting you start to say "Isn't that a waste of time?", see their face, and stop. On the way home, you think, "I should have just said it."
INFJ>INTJ.why: Thinking things through on your own and getting ready ahead of time is the same in your temperament and your type. The difference is how you decide. By nature you decide with your feelings, but along the way you got used to thinking with logic. So before you speak, you ask both "Is it right?" and "How will they feel?", and that takes time.
INFJ>INTJ.yure: The only difference between your temperament and your type is whether you decide with logic or with feelings. Picture yourself at work and you lean toward logic. Picture a friend asking for advice and you lean toward feelings, so your result can change.
INFJ>INTJ.plus: You take time choosing your words because you don't want to hurt anyone. You think before you speak, so people are willing to listen to you.
INFJ>INTJ.tip: For hard things, decide ahead of time to say the main point first. You can add the kind words after that.
INFJ>INTJ.hidden: People often see you as logical, but you were born good at noticing how people feel. When a coworker's reply is shorter than usual, don't you wonder if something's up? If you ask "Are you okay?" right then, people will find you easy to talk to.

INFJ>INTP.title: You listen, and then you can't help asking "why?"
INFJ>INTP.body: When a friend comes to you with a problem, before you know it you're thinking, "Wait, how did this even happen?" You've always liked thinking things through on your own and figuring out what things mean. You care about people's feelings, and you also like to dig into the logic. Some days you stick to the plan, and some days you change your mind on the spot.
INFJ>INTP.say: "I want to think it over alone. Can I get back to you tomorrow?"
INFJ>INTP.do: You start looking something up before bed, and suddenly two hours have passed.
INFJ>INTP.worry: You want to help people, but thinking gets so fun that you stop actually doing anything. Right after you make a plan, you think of a better way and start over.
INFJ>INTP.karai: You barely talk at the party, then sit lost in thought on the train home.
INFJ>INTP.aru: You were listening to a friend's problem, and suddenly you're asking "But why?" and looking for the cause. Later you realize, "Maybe they just wanted me to listen."
INFJ>INTP.why: Thinking things through on your own and figuring out what things mean is the same in your temperament and your type. Two things are different. By nature you decide with your feelings and like to stick to a plan. Along the way you picked up thinking with logic and changing your mind on the spot. That's why you listen kindly and still end up asking "why?"
INFJ>INTP.yure: The two differences are how you decide and whether you stick to a plan or go with the flow. Picture yourself helping a friend or picture yourself deep in research, and your result can change.
INFJ>INTP.plus: You think so hard you stop moving because you don't want to give a careless answer. The ideas you take time to reach really do help people.
INFJ>INTP.tip: When someone comes to you, first ask, "Do you want me to just listen, or think it through together?" Then you can give them what they need.
INFJ>INTP.hidden: You like letting your thoughts wander, but you were also born good at getting ready properly. The day before something important, don't you find yourself checking what to bring and what time to leave? Use that, and you'll see your ideas through to the end.

INFJ>ENTJ.title: Put you in charge, and things get decided fast.
INFJ>ENTJ.body: Right after saying "The deadline is Friday," you go check on someone who looks tired. Thinking ahead and following through on what you decide has never changed for you. You're good at standing up front and making calls, but you also need time alone to think.
INFJ>ENTJ.say: "Friday it is. If you think you can't make it, tell me early."
INFJ>ENTJ.do: When you set the schedule, you think "they're good at this" and split up the jobs that way.
INFJ>ENTJ.worry: The more you take charge, the less time you have alone. After you say something strict, you worry, "Was that too much?"
INFJ>ENTJ.karai: You make sure everyone gets their days off, but yours is always "sometime."
INFJ>ENTJ.aru: You organize the work dinner and handle everything from picking the place to splitting the bill. But on the train home you're worn out and don't want to talk to anyone.
INFJ>ENTJ.why: Thinking ahead and wanting things to go as planned is the same in your temperament and your type. Two things are different. By nature you recharge alone and decide with your feelings. Along the way you learned to stand up front and decide with logic. That's why, after you've been in charge, you want time alone to rest.
INFJ>ENTJ.yure: The two differences are whether people energize you or you recharge alone, and logic or feelings. Picture yourself leading a group or picture your day off, and your result can change.
INFJ>ENTJ.plus: You're worn out on the way home because you were looking out for everyone. When someone organizes things and also cares about people, everyone can relax and have fun.
INFJ>ENTJ.tip: Keep the day after you organize something free. It also helps to hand one job, like the bill, to someone else.
INFJ>ENTJ.hidden: You decide fast, so people see you as someone to lean on. But you were also born noticing right away when someone's face clouds over a little. Say a quick word then, and people will stay with you even when you have to be strict.

INFJ>ENTP.title: Once you start talking with people, the ideas don't stop.
INFJ>ENTP.body: When everyone's talking, ideas like "What if we did it this way?" keep coming. But you're also the one who wonders later if anyone felt bad during the talk. You've always loved new things and "what if" talk. You like talking with people, but once you get home you want time alone.
INFJ>ENTP.say: "Oh, nice! If we do this, it could be even more fun."
INFJ>ENTP.do: After a movie, you think up a different ending: "I'd have done it like this."
INFJ>ENTP.worry: Ideas keep coming when you're with people, but when you get home you're suddenly exhausted. Some days you want to act on a whim and some days you want a real plan, and you can't decide.
INFJ>ENTP.karai: When the talk turns to "what if we won the lottery," you suddenly get the most fired up.
INFJ>ENTP.aru: You're chatting with friends and get excited: "Let's do it!" But when you get home, you remember what you said and wonder, "Did I go too far?"
INFJ>ENTP.why: Loving new things and "what if" ideas is the same in your temperament and your type. Three things are different. By nature you recharge alone, decide with your feelings, and like to stick to a plan. Along the way you learned to talk ideas out with people, poke at them with logic, and go with the flow. That's why you talk a lot around people and look back alone at home.
INFJ>ENTP.yure: Three of the four are different, so your result can change a lot. Picture a day chatting with friends or picture yourself home alone, and getting a different type wouldn't be strange.
INFJ>ENTP.plus: You look back later because you were thinking about the other person even while having fun. You liven things up without leaving anyone behind, so people feel at ease with you.
INFJ>ENTP.tip: When you start going over the day, remember the most fun moment first, then go to sleep. Ending on a good feeling makes you want to see people again.
INFJ>ENTP.hidden: You often go with the mood, but you were also born good at making plans and following them. Before a trip, haven't you found you've already checked the train times and when the shops open? Use that, and the things you get excited about will actually happen.

INFJ>INFJ.title: You notice right away when a friend seems down.
INFJ>INFJ.body: You notice small changes in people. When someone at work sighs, you stop what you're doing and check on them. Thinking things through on your own, caring about how things could be, deciding with your feelings, and sticking to a plan have never changed for you.
INFJ>INFJ.say: "Don't push yourself. I'm always here to listen."
INFJ>INFJ.do: You remember a dream a friend once mentioned, and when you find an article that fits, you quietly send it to them.
INFJ>INFJ.worry: While you go along with everyone, you stop saying what you want to do. When something you hoped for doesn't work out, some days you feel down on your own.
INFJ>INFJ.karai: You'll help with a friend's problem until midnight, but you don't notice that you're tired.
INFJ>INFJ.aru: When a friend says "I'm fine," you can hear in their voice that they're not. You keep thinking about them for the rest of the day.
INFJ>INFJ.why: In both your temperament and your type, you think things through alone, value ideas, decide with your feelings, and stick to a plan. All four are the same, so your knack for noticing how people feel has grown strong. Because you notice so much, you also get tired easily.
INFJ>INFJ.yure: You'll likely get almost the same result every time. If a different type shows up, you may be in a stretch of listening to a lot of people and feeling worn out.
INFJ>INFJ.plus: You notice small changes because you really watch the people around you. There are people near you who feel, "They get me."
INFJ>INFJ.tip: On nights when someone stays on your mind, take 30 minutes for yourself, like a bath or a favorite video, before bed. It helps your mind switch off so you can rest.
INFJ>INFJ.hidden: You like things to go as planned, but you can also enjoy going with the flow. It's that feeling when a shop you wandered into on a day off turns out to be fun. Leave a day unplanned now and then, and you'll feel lighter.

INFJ>INFP.title: You get really drawn into the books and songs you love.
INFJ>INFP.body: When a friend tells you about something hard, it hurts you as if it happened to you. Recharging alone and caring about ideas and people's feelings has never changed for you. You like making plans, but some days you want to change them on the spot.
INFJ>INFP.say: "These lyrics feel like they're about me. They made me cry."
INFJ>INFP.do: You buy a novel at the bookstore because the cover caught your eye, and finish it alone that night.
INFJ>INFP.worry: When you can't stick to a plan, you think, "I'm no good." But when you pack your schedule, that feels hard too.
INFJ>INFP.karai: After saying no to plans, you worry "Did that sound rude?" until bedtime.
INFJ>INFP.aru: At New Year's you decided to "do yoga every morning," but by day three it's "A walk is fine today." You didn't quit, but you still feel a little bad about it.
INFJ>INFP.why: Recharging alone and caring about ideas and people's feelings is the same in your temperament and your type. Only one thing is different. By nature you like to stick to a plan, but along the way you also learned to go with how you feel that day. That's why, even after you make a plan, you want to change it.
INFJ>INFP.yure: The only difference is whether you stick to a plan or go with the flow. Picture a work deadline and you lean toward planning. Picture your day off and you lean toward going with the flow.
INFJ>INFP.plus: If you keep going even when you change the plan, you've found a way that fits you. Little by little, you're moving forward.
INFJ>INFP.tip: Instead of deciding on "yoga," try something looser like "move my body in the morning." You can pick what to do based on your mood, so you'll have more days you did it.
INFJ>INFP.hidden: You often change plans based on your mood, but you were born good at thinking ahead and getting things in order. On trips with friends, don't you somehow end up the one who sets the meeting time and picks the trains? Use that, and people at work will feel safe leaving things to you.

INFJ>ENFJ.title: When people get together, you end up in charge.
INFJ>ENFJ.body: At get-togethers you keep everyone together, and when you get home you rest quietly on your own. Thinking ahead, caring about people's feelings, and keeping things on plan has never changed for you. You're good at leading people, but you need time alone to rest just as much.
INFJ>ENFJ.say: "I reached out to the people who haven't been coming lately, too."
INFJ>ENFJ.do: You remember what your juniors are good at, and when a job that fits comes up, you let them know.
INFJ>ENFJ.worry: You're happy to help people, but you look up and have no time to yourself. You like being relied on, but sometimes you just want to be left alone.
INFJ>ENFJ.karai: Your trip plan has everyone's must-see spots except yours.
INFJ>ENFJ.aru: At get-togethers with friends, you're naturally the one getting everyone talking. But on the way home, you turn off your phone notifications and don't want to talk to anyone.
INFJ>ENFJ.why: Caring about people's feelings, thinking ahead, and keeping things on plan is the same in your temperament and your type. Only one thing is different. By nature you recharge alone, and along the way you learned to take the lead around people. You rest alone to make up for the effort you put in around others, so you're not forcing yourself.
INFJ>ENFJ.yure: The only difference is whether people energize you or you recharge alone. Picture yourself getting everyone talking or picture yourself on the way home, and your result can change.
INFJ>ENFJ.plus: You don't want to talk afterward because you really showed up for everyone. You put real effort into the get-together, so people want to come again.
INFJ>ENFJ.tip: Keep the evening after a get-together free, with no plans. Knowing you have time to rest lets you look forward to the day itself.
INFJ>ENFJ.hidden: You're good at leading groups, but you were also born good at thinking things over alone. Don't you sometimes realize later, "Oh, maybe that's what they meant," about something a friend said in passing? Use that, and you'll understand how people feel even better.

INFJ>ENFP.title: You hit it off quickly, even with people you just met.
INFJ>ENFP.body: You start chatting easily with people you've just met, and you still notice the feelings they don't say out loud. Caring about ideas and people's feelings has never changed for you. Some days you light up around people, and some days you want to be quiet on your own.
INFJ>ENFP.say: "Ooh, I like that! Tell me more."
INFJ>ENFP.do: You hit it off with someone you just met and swap contact info right there.
INFJ>ENFP.worry: The more fun the day, the more tired you are that night. The things you want to do keep piling up, and it feels like you're only halfway on all of them.
INFJ>ENFP.karai: While listening to a friend's crush story, you're already picturing their wedding.
INFJ>ENFP.aru: When someone invites you, you say "I'm in!" right away. But on the morning of, you're in bed thinking, "Maybe I don't want to go after all."
INFJ>ENFP.why: Caring about ideas and people's feelings is the same in your temperament and your type. Two things are different. By nature you recharge alone and like to stick to a plan. Along the way you learned to get energy from people and act on a whim. That's why looking forward to it and wanting to rest both show up on the same morning.
INFJ>ENFP.yure: The two differences are whether people energize you or you recharge alone, and whether you stick to a plan or go with the flow. Picture yourself having fun with friends or picture a quiet night alone, and your result can change.
INFJ>ENFP.plus: You hesitate in the morning because if you go, you want to really enjoy it. The more time you take to rest, the brighter you can be when you see people.
INFJ>ENFP.tip: When you reply to an invite, try adding when you'll leave, like "I can stay until 9." Knowing when you'll head home makes that morning easier.
INFJ>ENFP.hidden: You often act on a whim, but you were born good at making plans and sticking with them. When you start a new hobby, don't you get the gear and decide "every Saturday"? Use that, and you'll keep going with the things you want to do.

INFJ>ISTJ.title: Your work is precise, and you're kind when you teach.
INFJ>ISTJ.body: You do your work carefully and by the steps, but when someone's having trouble, you stop and listen. That's why people say, "If you're on it, I'm not worried." Thinking calmly on your own and keeping things on plan has never changed for you.
INFJ>ISTJ.say: "The steps look good. I'll just add one thing here."
INFJ>ISTJ.do: After teaching a new hire, you always add, "Ask me anytime."
INFJ>ISTJ.worry: You want to follow the rules, but once you hear someone's situation, you start to waver. Even when you're curious about what's ahead, you can't move without solid reasons.
INFJ>ISTJ.karai: A sudden "Can you come now?" gets a no, because you had plans to lie around at home.
INFJ>ISTJ.aru: You mean to say "Sorry, those are the rules," but as you listen to them, you start thinking, "Maybe just this once..."
INFJ>ISTJ.why: Thinking calmly on your own and keeping things on plan is the same in your temperament and your type. Two things are different. By nature you trust your hunches and decide with your feelings. Along the way you learned to check the facts and decide with logic. That's why you get stuck between the rules and the other person's feelings.
INFJ>ISTJ.yure: The two differences are hunches or facts, and logic or feelings. Picture work steps or picture a friend asking for advice, and your result can change.
INFJ>ISTJ.plus: You waver because you care about both the rules and the person. You think it through before you answer, so people accept your call.
INFJ>ISTJ.tip: When you can't decide on an exception, ask, "Could I do the same for everyone?" If you could, you won't feel uneasy later.
INFJ>ISTJ.hidden: You check the facts and the usual way of doing things, but you were also born good at coming up with new ways. In the middle of routine work, don't you sometimes think, "This would be easier if..."? Say it out loud, and you'll get trusted with new work.

INFJ>ISFJ.title: You worry, so you always pack a little extra.
INFJ>ISFJ.body: When a friend moves, you show up with work gloves and drinks for everyone. Recharging alone, caring about people's feelings, and keeping things on plan has never changed for you. You think ahead, remember what happened before, and get well prepared.
INFJ>ISFJ.do: You remember a coworker's birthday and hand them a small snack that morning.
INFJ>ISFJ.worry: Thinking about what might happen makes you worry, and you keep adding to your prep. Getting things ready for others comes first, and what you want to do gets pushed back.
INFJ>ISFJ.karai: Even a one-line LINE reply gets reread three times before you send it.
INFJ>ISFJ.aru: The day before a family trip, you think "What if it rains?" and "What if someone gets a stomachache?" and only your bag is stuffed. Everyone else is ready, and you forgot your own toothbrush.
INFJ>ISFJ.why: Recharging alone, caring about people's feelings, and keeping things on plan is the same in your temperament and your type. Only one thing is different. By nature you imagine what's ahead, and along the way you learned to prepare based on past experience and the facts in front of you. That's why you think "This might happen" and get well prepared.
INFJ>ISFJ.yure: The only difference is hunches or facts and experience. Picture your future dreams and you lean toward hunches. Picture everyday chores and you lean toward experience.
INFJ>ISFJ.plus: Your bag gets heavy because you don't want the people you love to be stuck. Someone has definitely been saved by a bandage from your bag.
INFJ>ISFJ.tip: When you pack, put your own wallet, phone, and toothbrush in first. If your things go in first, you won't forget anything.
INFJ>ISFJ.hidden: You take care of what's in front of you, step by step, but you were also born good at noticing the feelings behind words. When someone in your family says "It's fine," don't you sometimes sense they don't really mean it? Ask "What's up?" then, and they'll find you easier to talk to.

INFJ>ESTJ.title: Once you decide something, you see it through.
INFJ>ESTJ.body: When you suggest changing how things work at the office, what you're really thinking is "so everyone can go home earlier." Setting a direction and following through has never changed for you. You give clear instructions in front of people, but sometimes you worry afterward about how they felt.
INFJ>ESTJ.say: "Please keep to the deadline. If you get stuck, tell me early."
INFJ>ESTJ.do: When you hand out tasks, you give lighter work to anyone who looks unwell.
INFJ>ESTJ.worry: The more you lead, the less time you have to think alone. You want to settle what needs doing, but you also care how people feel, and that makes you hesitate.
INFJ>ESTJ.karai: The night before a trip, you can't sleep until everything you're bringing is lined up by the door.
INFJ>ESTJ.aru: At work you say clearly, "Please have this done by this date." That night in the bath, you remember it and think, "Was I cold?" and feel down.
INFJ>ESTJ.why: Setting a direction and following the plan to the end is the same in your temperament and your type. Three things are different. By nature you recharge alone, trust your hunches, and decide with your feelings. Along the way you learned to act quickly around people and move things forward with facts and logic. That's why, after you speak plainly, you worry about how the other person felt.
INFJ>ESTJ.yure: Three of the four are different, so your result can change a lot. Picture yourself leading at work or picture yourself thinking alone, and you might get a different type.
INFJ>ESTJ.plus: You worry about how you said it because you really care about the other person. A senior who makes the calls and still thinks about people makes the office feel safe.
INFJ>ESTJ.tip: After you say something plainly, add, "Let me know if anything comes up." They'll find it easier to come to you, and you'll worry less at night.
INFJ>ESTJ.hidden: You move things forward with facts and planning, but you were also born good at imagining what's ahead. On your commute, don't you sometimes think, "It'd be great if we could do this in a few years"? Share that with your team, and it'll get them excited too.

INFJ>ESFJ.title: At get-togethers, you check that everyone's having fun.
INFJ>ESFJ.body: At get-togethers you move around with a smile, and you still notice the one person who seems down. Caring about people's feelings and thinking ahead has never changed for you. After being around people, you need time alone to rest.
INFJ>ESFJ.say: "You seem a little down. Want to grab tea on the way home?"
INFJ>ESFJ.do: When an older neighbor is carrying something heavy, you carry it to her door.
INFJ>ESFJ.worry: You want to see people happy, so you do too much, and once you're alone you're suddenly exhausted. You don't want to ruin the mood, so sometimes you can't say what you want to.
INFJ>ESFJ.karai: Planning seats for a dinner, you spend ages deciding who sits next to whom.
INFJ>ESFJ.aru: You invite the new person to lunch and show them the ropes so they don't feel left out. Your own work falls behind, and you end up staying late.
INFJ>ESFJ.why: Caring about people's feelings and getting ready according to plan is the same in your temperament and your type. Two things are different. By nature you recharge alone and think about what things mean. Along the way you learned to move around people and notice right away when someone needs help. After working that hard around people, it's natural to feel drained when you're alone.
INFJ>ESFJ.yure: The two differences are whether people energize you or you recharge alone, and hunches or facts. Picture yourself busy at a get-together or picture yourself alone thinking about the future, and your result can change.
INFJ>ESFJ.plus: You keep going until you're worn out because you want everyone to have a good time. At a get-together with you there, even the people on the edges feel comfortable.
INFJ>ESFJ.tip: Decide ahead how long you'll help others, like "just 30 minutes at lunch." Your own work gets done too, so you can be kind without feeling rushed.
INFJ>ESFJ.hidden: You quickly notice when someone needs help right now, but you were also born good at imagining what's ahead. While listening to a friend, don't you sometimes think, "This kind of job would suit them"? Tell them, and it'll give them a real lift.

INFJ>ISTP.title: You don't say much, but you jump in when someone needs help.
INFJ>ISTP.body: When you help a friend move, you don't talk much, you just carry the heavy furniture. Recharging alone and quietly watching what's going on around you has never changed for you. You show how you feel by doing things more than by saying them.
INFJ>ISTP.say: "I focus better alone, so I'll get started on it."
INFJ>ISTP.do: On your day off, you build a plastic model kit alone and the whole day is gone.
INFJ>ISTP.worry: You show care through actions more than words, so sometimes your kindness doesn't come across. You can't tell if you want to think hard about the future or just do what you can right now.
INFJ>ISTP.karai: You say "I like being alone," but you read every message in the group chat.
INFJ>ISTP.aru: When a coworker's computer acts up, you go over and fix it right away. But a simple "Are you okay?" is hard to get out.
INFJ>ISTP.why: Thinking calmly on your own is the same in your temperament and your type. Three things are different. By nature you trust your hunches, decide with your feelings, and like to stick to a plan. Along the way you learned to look at the facts, think with logic, and get your hands moving on the spot. That's why, when you care about someone, your hands move before your words.
INFJ>ISTP.yure: Three of the four are different, so your result can change a lot. Picture yourself fixing something or picture yourself thinking about someone you care about, and a different type may come up.
INFJ>ISTP.plus: Your hands move before your words because you want to fix their problem fast. Quiet help like that gets noticed later.
INFJ>ISTP.tip: After you help, add just one line: "Does that look okay now?" That alone shows you care.
INFJ>ISTP.hidden: You're good at acting on the spot, but you were also born good at thinking ahead and putting things in order. The night before a day off, don't you think, "Tomorrow I'll do this, then that"? Use that, and you'll be trusted with bigger work.

INFJ>ISFP.title: You show your feelings with small gifts.
INFJ>ISFP.body: When you can't find the words, you give a small gift instead. That's your way. Valuing quiet time alone and caring about people's feelings has never changed for you. You do think ahead, but you often go with your mood.
INFJ>ISFP.say: "This felt so you, I had to buy it."
INFJ>ISFP.do: When a friend is down, you buy their favorite snack and hand it over: "You like these, right?"
INFJ>ISFP.worry: You know you should think about the future, but you want to honor how you feel right now, so you can't decide. Sad news can bring you down for a whole day.
INFJ>ISFP.karai: After a party you couldn't say no to, you get home and can't get off the couch.
INFJ>ISFP.aru: You think, "I really need to think about my future," but your day off ends with a tour of your favorite gift shops. On the way home, you think, "Didn't get to it again."
INFJ>ISFP.why: Recharging alone and caring about people's feelings is the same in your temperament and your type. Two things are different. By nature you think ahead and like to stick to a plan. Along the way you came to value what's in front of you and how you feel now, and to go with the flow. That's why you get stuck between the future and today's fun.
INFJ>ISFP.yure: The two differences are hunches or facts, and sticking to a plan or going with the flow. Picture your future plans or picture today's fun, and your result can change.
INFJ>ISFP.plus: You lose track of time in gift shops because you can see what's good about the things in front of you. That's also why you're so good at picking gifts.
INFJ>ISFP.tip: Set a time for the future, like "30 minutes at a café once a month." The rest of your days off, you can just enjoy them.
INFJ>ISFP.hidden: You often go with your mood, but you were born good at making plans and getting ready. Before a trip, don't you look up the shops you want to visit ahead of time? Use that, and you can keep doing the things you love for a long time.

INFJ>ESTP.title: When the idea hits, you're already out the door.
INFJ>ESTP.body: You head out on a whim, and on the way home you're listening closely to a friend's worries. Your temperament and type differ in all four, so you can do a wide range of things. During the day you act fast, but at night you think over the day alone.
INFJ>ESTP.say: "Since we're out anyway, let's hit one more place on the way home."
INFJ>ESTP.do: When you get lost on a trip, you ask a local for directions and get a restaurant tip while you're at it.
INFJ>ESTP.worry: Being with everyone is fun, but when you get home you're suddenly exhausted. People see you as easygoing, so they don't notice how much you actually think.
INFJ>ESTP.karai: You were listening to a friend vent, and now you're angrier than they are.
INFJ>ESTP.aru: New restaurants, new activities, you're the first to say "Let's go!" But alone at night, something someone said that afternoon keeps bugging you.
INFJ>ESTP.why: Your temperament and type are different in all four. By nature you recharge alone, care about meaning and people's feelings, and like to stick to a plan. Along the way you learned to get energy from people, look at the facts, decide quickly with logic, and act on the spot. That's why you move fast during the day and think things over alone at night.
INFJ>ESTP.yure: All four are different, so your result can change a lot. Picture yourself out having fun or picture yourself alone at night thinking, and you might get a totally different type.
INFJ>ESTP.plus: You go back over what people said because you don't take their words lightly. Someone who's fun and also thinks things through is someone people rely on.
INFJ>ESTP.tip: On nights when a comment won't leave your head, decide "I'll think about it tomorrow morning" and go to sleep. By morning, it usually bothers you less than you expected.
INFJ>ESTP.hidden: You often say "Let's just go," but you were born good at thinking ahead and getting ready. The night before an outing, don't you quietly look up the train home? Use that, and people will feel safe being around you.

INFJ>ESFP.title: After getting everyone going, you wonder, "Did she have fun?"
INFJ>ESFP.body: You were the most excited one at the party, and on the way home you're wondering, "Did she have a good time?" Deciding with people's feelings in mind never changes, wherever you are. You love having fun with everyone, but you also need time alone to rest.
INFJ>ESFP.say: "Today's so much fun! Hey, let's go get her to join us too."
INFJ>ESFP.do: When a friend gets a haircut, you notice right away and say, "It looks great!"
INFJ>ESFP.worry: After going all out having fun, you can't recover without time alone. You want to enjoy right now, but the future is on your mind a little too.
INFJ>ESFP.karai: At a sad movie, you cry because your friend next to you is crying.
INFJ>ESFP.aru: At karaoke you're the one getting everyone going, singing loud. But when you get home, you flop onto the couch and can't move for a while.
INFJ>ESFP.why: Deciding with people's feelings in mind is the same in your temperament and your type. Three things are different. By nature you recharge alone, think about what things mean, and like to stick to a plan. Along the way you learned to get energy from people, enjoy the moment, and go with the flow. After all that fun in front of people, you rest with time alone.
INFJ>ESFP.yure: Three of the four are different, so your result can change each time. Picture yourself out having fun or picture a quiet night alone, and a different type may come up.
INFJ>ESFP.plus: You can't move on the couch because you were giving it everything for everyone. When you're there, the whole get-together feels brighter.
INFJ>ESFP.tip: After a fun day out, keep the next morning as "do-nothing time." Set out your loungewear before you leave so you can rest as soon as you're back.
INFJ>ESFP.hidden: You're great at enjoying the moment, but you were also born good at picturing what's ahead. Don't you sometimes think, "Next year I'd like to try this"? Hold on to that, and you can keep having fun while getting closer to what you want to do.

INFP>INTJ.title: Someone who's always thinking about something.
INFP>INTJ.body: When you get into a TV drama, you look up every hint and the order of events, and spend more time on theories than on the show. Thinking things through alone and imagining things that don't exist yet has never changed for you. Once you know what you want to do, you work out the steps and get going.
INFP>INTJ.say: "I know what I want to do. Now I just need to figure out the order."
INFP>INTJ.do: When you decide to redo your room, you save photos of rooms you like and even measure your furniture.
INFP>INTJ.worry: The more efficiently things go, the more you stop and ask, "Is this actually fun?" Even for things you want to choose by feel, you end up looking for reasons.
INFP>INTJ.karai: Once you start thinking, you sometimes miss your stop.
INFP>INTJ.aru: You're just picking a café, but you spend 30 minutes comparing reviews and prices. And in the end you pick it because "I just like this one."
INFP>INTJ.why: Thinking things through alone and imagining what doesn't exist yet is the same in your temperament and your type. Two things are different. By nature you're honest about your feelings and enjoy going with the flow. Along the way you learned to think with logic and plan ahead. That's why you want to check things with both your feelings and your logic.
INFP>INTJ.yure: The two differences are logic or feelings, and sticking to a plan or going with the flow. Picture yourself planning work or picture yourself doing something you love, and your result can change.
INFP>INTJ.plus: You can choose by "I like it" in the end because efficiency alone doesn't satisfy you. You look things up well before you choose, so you take good care of what you pick for a long time.
INFP>INTJ.tip: When you're choosing something you like, try a rule: "Ten minutes of research, max." You'll pick by feel in the end anyway, so you can decide before you're worn out.
INFP>INTJ.hidden: You're good at sticking to the plan, but you were also born able to enjoy the moment. On a trip, don't you sometimes want to wander down a street that wasn't on the plan? Use that, and you can enjoy it instead of panicking when plans change.

INFP>INTP.title: When something makes you cry, you want to know why.
INFP>INTP.body: When the talk turns to your favorite manga, you can't stop, and you can explain what's great about it both by feel and by logic. Loving time alone, valuing your ideas, and following your interests has never changed for you. You care about people's feelings, but you also like thinking things through logically.
INFP>INTP.say: "I wonder how far space actually goes."
INFP>INTP.do: You start looking up where a word comes from and are still reading at midnight.
INFP>INTP.worry: If you can't explain what you felt with logic, you can't settle down. Sometimes you think so much that you can't just enjoy things.
INFP>INTP.karai: While deciding what to do on your day off, you're still in bed and it's evening.
INFP>INTP.aru: After a movie with a friend, they say "That was good" and leave it there, but you spend the whole way home talking about why it made you cry.
INFP>INTP.why: Loving time alone, valuing your ideas, and doing things your own way is the same in your temperament and your type. Only one thing is different. By nature you decide with your feelings, and along the way you came to think with logic and want to know how things work. That's why you want to know the reason behind what moved you.
INFP>INTP.yure: The only difference is logic or feelings. Picture yourself researching something and you lean toward logic. Picture yourself watching something you love and you lean toward feelings.
INFP>INTP.plus: You want to know why something moved you because that feeling matters to you. You can put what you felt into words, so your thoughts on things are fun to hear.
INFP>INTP.tip: With movies or music, try enjoying them the first time without thinking, and thinking about them the second time. That way you don't lose either kind of fun.
INFP>INTP.hidden: You're good at thinking with logic, but you were also born good at noticing how people feel. When a friend is down, don't you sometimes say "That sounds really hard" before giving any advice? That one line makes it easier for them to keep talking.

INFP>ENTJ.title: You set the goal and lead the way.
INFP>ENTJ.body: In meetings you state the goal clearly, and at the end you say, "I really love this project." Loving to imagine things that don't exist yet has never changed for you. You're good at standing up front and deciding, but time alone doing what you love matters too.
INFP>ENTJ.say: "Let's finish it this month. I really like this project."
INFP>ENTJ.do: While helping a junior with a problem, you break it down for them: "First this, then this."
INFP>ENTJ.worry: The more you lead, the less time you have alone for what you love. On days you make a strict call, you keep wondering, "Was that right?"
INFP>ENTJ.karai: You were talking about this trip, and somehow you've already picked the next one.
INFP>ENTJ.aru: At work you decide things quickly and people rely on you. But at home, if you don't get time to zone out to your favorite music, you can't recharge.
INFP>ENTJ.why: Loving to imagine what doesn't exist yet is the same in your temperament and your type. Three things are different. By nature you recharge alone, decide with your feelings, and go with the flow. Along the way you learned to stand up front, decide with logic, and see things through. That's why, after a strict call, your own feelings start to bother you.
INFP>ENTJ.yure: Three of the four are different, so your result can change a lot. Picture yourself leading a team or picture yourself lost in something you love, and a different type may come up.
INFP>ENTJ.plus: You think it over afterward because your own feelings matter to you. People follow a leader who talks about what they love, not just the goal.
INFP>ENTJ.tip: On days you make a strict call, decide to listen to one favorite song on the way home. For anyone you're worried about, a simple "Thanks for yesterday" the next day is enough.
INFP>ENTJ.hidden: You decide things firmly and move forward, but you were also born able to enjoy going with the flow. Have you ever gone out on a day off with no plan and found a great shop by chance? Use that, and you can stay calm when things don't go as planned.

INFP>ENTP.title: You say exactly what you think, then worry about it later.
INFP>ENTP.body: Right after you say, "Wouldn't it be fun if we flipped it?", you quietly check the other person's face. Valuing your ideas and going with the flow has never changed for you. You like talking with people, but you also need time alone to think.
INFP>ENTP.say: "Wait, what you just said gave me an idea."
INFP>ENTP.do: You and a friend get excited, "That would be a hit as a video!", and you keep thinking up ideas after you get home.
INFP>ENTP.worry: You come up with lots of ideas but can't narrow them down to one. You never seem to get enough time with people or enough time alone.
INFP>ENTP.karai: Every new hobby: buy all the gear, then move on to the next.
INFP>ENTP.aru: The conversation gets fun and you tease a friend a little too hard. That night in bed you think, "Did I hurt them?" and keep typing and deleting a sorry message.
INFP>ENTP.why: Valuing your ideas and going with the flow is the same in your temperament and your type. Two things are different. By nature you recharge alone and decide with your feelings. Along the way you learned to talk ideas out with people and push them with logic. That's why, after you say something blunt, you worry about how they felt.
INFP>ENTP.yure: The two differences are whether people energize you or you recharge alone, and logic or feelings. Picture yourself having fun with friends or picture yourself lost in thought alone, and your result can change.
INFP>ENTP.plus: You remember it at night because the other person matters more to you than winning. Someone who says fun things and checks in afterward is easy to talk to.
INFP>ENTP.tip: When you say something sharp, add with a laugh right then, "I'm just throwing out ideas." Saying it on the spot is much easier than worrying all night.
INFP>ENTP.hidden: You're good at growing ideas by talking with people, but you were also born good at imagining deeply on your own. When you're listening to music alone, don't stories and ideas sometimes come one after another? Protect that time, and your ideas will be easier to turn into something real.

INFP>INFJ.title: You start things on a whim and keep at them.
INFP>INFJ.body: You started a hobby on a whim, and before you know it you've scheduled your practice. Resting your mind alone and caring about ideas and people's feelings has never changed for you. You like going with your mood, but getting ready ahead of time makes you feel safe.
INFP>INFJ.say: "This view feels kind of nostalgic somehow."
INFP>INFJ.do: At night, you turn off the lights and play your favorite song over and over by yourself.
INFP>INFJ.worry: You want to stay free, but you also want things settled, so you keep adding plans and deleting them. Trying to meet people's expectations, you sometimes put your own feelings last.
INFP>INFJ.karai: Even after the movie credits end, you can't quite get up from your seat.
INFP>INFJ.aru: It was an exhibit you'd go to "if you felt like it," but days ahead you've already got the ticket and your outfit ready.
INFP>INFJ.why: Resting your mind alone and caring about ideas and people's feelings is the same in your temperament and your type. Only one thing is different. By nature you like to follow your mood, and along the way you learned to think ahead and get ready. That's why you can keep going with things you started on a whim.
INFP>INFJ.yure: The only difference is sticking to a plan or going with the flow. Picture plans with other people and you lean toward planning. Picture a day off alone and you lean toward going with the flow.
INFP>INFJ.plus: You add and delete plans because you're looking for what works for you. You value your gut and still get ready, so you actually do what you want to do.
INFP>INFJ.tip: For invites you're unsure about, say early on, "I'll come if I can." Once you know it's okay to skip, you won't over-prepare.
INFP>INFJ.hidden: You get well prepared before you act, but you were also born light on your feet. On the way home, don't you sometimes want to take a different street just because? Use that, and you can enjoy it when plans suddenly change.

INFP>INFP.title: You hold on to the things you "just like."
INFP>INFP.body: When you find a little item you love in a shop, you can't move away from it for a while. Your temperament and type point the same way, so caring about what you love, noticing when people are hurting, and showing your feelings in your own way have grown just as they are. In places that fit you, you can relax and be yourself, but in places that don't, you tend to lose your energy without knowing why.
INFP>INFP.say: "That's so lovely. ...I can't really explain it, but it's just nice, you know?"
INFP>INFP.do: On the way home after the rain, the sky in a puddle looks so pretty that you take the long way.
INFP>INFP.worry: If you keep doing things that don't fit how you feel, you lose energy without knowing why. The harder you try to fit in, the more you forget what you used to like.
INFP>INFP.karai: In your head you've gone on trip after trip, but on your actual days off you barely leave the house.
INFP>INFP.aru: When you think "I just like this," you can't let it go even if you can't say why. When someone asks "What's so good about it?", all you can say is "I don't know, I just do."
INFP>INFP.why: Your temperament and type point the same way, so caring about what you love and resting your feelings with time alone have grown just as they are. Your likes and dislikes are clear, and your feelings answer before any reason does. It means you really know how you feel.
INFP>INFP.yure: Your temperament and type are the same, so you tend to get similar results every time. If a different type shows up, you may be going through a stretch of fitting in with others and putting your own likes last.
INFP>INFP.plus: You can love things without a reason because you trust how you feel. The "this is nice" you can't explain is something only you can find.
INFP>INFP.tip: When someone asks "What's so good about it?", name just one thing you like. Even "I like the color" gets it across.
INFP>INFP.hidden: You also have the ability to think things through with logic. You just haven't used it much yet. While looking up something you love, haven't you suddenly realized, "Oh, that's why I like it"? Use that, and it'll be easier to share what you love with others.

INFP>ENFJ.title: You gather friends to make your ideas happen.
INFP>ENFJ.body: You come up with a small event and reach out to friends to get people together. Valuing your ideas and deciding with people's feelings in mind has never changed for you. You like leading the group, but without time alone you wear out.
INFP>ENFJ.say: "If we all do it, we've got this! I already made the schedule."
INFP>ENFJ.do: When a friend is down, you say "Let's get dinner soon" and send a few possible dates.
INFP>ENFJ.worry: While cheering others on, you lose your time alone to rest. The more you plan around everyone, the less free you feel.
INFP>ENFJ.karai: You cheer on everyone's dreams with all you've got, but when it's your dream, your voice gets quiet.
INFP>ENFJ.aru: At your club's event you lead everyone and hear "You're so dependable." But afterward, you can't settle down until you put in earbuds and play your favorite song.
INFP>ENFJ.why: Valuing your ideas and deciding with people's feelings in mind is the same in your temperament and your type. Two things are different. By nature you recharge alone and follow your mood. Along the way you learned to lead in a group and plan ahead. After working hard in front of people, it's natural to need time alone.
INFP>ENFJ.yure: The two differences are whether people energize you or you recharge alone, and sticking to a plan or going with the flow. Picture yourself running an event or picture yourself resting alone, and your result can change.
INFP>ENFJ.plus: Resting alone after leading is how people keep going for the long run. Someone who can cheer others on can take good care of themselves too.
INFP>ENFJ.tip: When you plan for everyone, pick your own rest day first and tell them, "I can't do that day." If you say it early, you'll actually get to rest.
INFP>ENFJ.hidden: You plan ahead and bring people together, but you were also born free to follow your mood. On a day with no plans, don't you want to just get on a train without picking a place? Use that, and you can laugh and start over when plans fall apart.

INFP>ENFP.title: You replay the fun days alone at night.
INFP>ENFP.body: On a night after you had everyone laughing, you think back over the day alone and enjoy it all over again. Valuing your ideas, deciding with your feelings, and going with the flow has never changed for you. People give you energy, but you love time alone just as much.
INFP>ENFP.say: "Hey, listen! I just had the best dream."
INFP>ENFP.do: When you go out, you make friends with strangers too and end up taking photos together.
INFP>ENFP.worry: You love seeing people, but if you see them too much, you suddenly don't want to talk to anyone. You can't predict those waves yourself, and you feel bad after turning down plans.
INFP>ENFP.karai: Once your favorite manga comes up, you can't stop, and you're the only one talking.
INFP>ENFP.aru: You were having fun at the party until the very end, but on the train home you put in earbuds and slip into your own world.
INFP>ENFP.why: Valuing your ideas, deciding with your feelings, and going with the flow is the same in your temperament and your type. Only one thing is different. By nature you recharge alone, and along the way you also started getting energy from people. That's why some days you want to see people and some days you want to be alone.
INFP>ENFP.yure: The only difference is whether people energize you or you recharge alone. Take it after a day out with friends or after a day off alone, and your result can change.
INFP>ENFP.plus: Having days you don't want to see anyone means you want your time with people to be good. After a rest, you're back to making everyone laugh.
INFP>ENFP.tip: Try a limit of two social plans a week, and you'll have fewer days where you suddenly crash. When you say no, just be honest: "I want to see you when I've got energy." Most people will get it.
INFP>ENFP.hidden: You get close to anyone fast, but you were born good at sitting with your own feelings alone. On a walk by yourself, don't you sometimes realize, "This is what matters to me"? Use that, and you can choose your own path at school or work without being swept along.

INFP>ISTJ.title: Whatever you're asked to do, you finish it with care.
INFP>ISTJ.body: You finish the report you were asked for, neatly, and quietly fuss over the colors and fonts too. Loving quiet time alone to think has never changed for you. You do your work seriously, but inside you're thinking about what you want to do.
INFP>ISTJ.say: "I'm heading out on time today. See you tomorrow."
INFP>ISTJ.do: The day before you go somewhere, you double-check what to bring and what time to leave.
INFP>ISTJ.worry: You get everything done properly, yet sometimes you think, "Is this what I wanted to do?" Even when starting something you love, you want a reason and a plan first.
INFP>ISTJ.karai: You smile at the work party, but inside you keep thinking, "I want to go home."
INFP>ISTJ.aru: At work people call you "so organized." But at home, you watch your favorite movie and cry by yourself.
INFP>ISTJ.why: Thinking quietly on your own is the same in your temperament and your type. Three things are different. By nature you imagine things that don't exist yet, decide with your feelings, and follow your mood. Along the way you learned to build on facts, decide with logic, and finish things as planned. That's why you do your work properly while thinking about what you love inside.
INFP>ISTJ.yure: Three of the four are different, so your result can change each time. Picture yourself at work or picture yourself alone doing what you love, and a different type may come up.
INFP>ISTJ.plus: You can ask "Is this what I wanted?" because you still remember what you want to do. And you already have what it takes to turn it into a plan.
INFP>ISTJ.tip: Once a week, make time for something you love with no reason and no deadline. If it sticks, add it to your schedule. That's about right.
INFP>ISTJ.hidden: You do what's asked of you accurately, but you were also born good at imagining what doesn't exist yet. Between tasks, don't you sometimes think, "It'd be fun if there were a shop like this"? Say those ideas out loud, and people will see how interesting you are.

INFP>ISFJ.title: You quietly keep your family's days running.
INFP>ISFJ.body: You sneak one of your family's favorite side dishes into their lunch box. Resting your mind alone and deciding with people's feelings in mind has never changed for you. You keep everything running every day, and inside you hold on to a small dream too.
INFP>ISFJ.do: When someone in your family has a fever, you make rice porridge without a word and bring it to them.
INFP>ISFJ.worry: With days full of routine tasks, your time for what you love keeps shrinking. You're glad to be useful, but sometimes you wonder, "What did I want to do again?"
INFP>ISFJ.karai: Even when the wrong dish comes, you eat it because you feel bad for the server.
INFP>ISFJ.aru: You remember family birthdays, trash day, and your friends' favorite foods. But your own "someday I want to..." hasn't moved in years.
INFP>ISFJ.why: Resting your mind alone and caring about people's feelings is the same in your temperament and your type. Two things are different. By nature you imagine what doesn't exist yet and follow your mood. Along the way you learned to use past experience and keep things on plan. Your ability to support others grew strong, so your own dream just got pushed back a little.
INFP>ISFJ.yure: The two differences are hunches or facts, and sticking to a plan or going with the flow. Picture daily chores and work or picture yourself daydreaming alone, and your result can change.
INFP>ISFJ.plus: You remember so much about people because you care about them. Turn a bit of that care toward your own dream, and it will start moving.
INFP>ISFJ.tip: Pick one "day for what I love" each month and tell your family ahead of time. When everyone knows about it, it's harder to push aside.
INFP>ISFJ.hidden: You keep every day running smoothly, but you were also born light on your feet. Don't you sometimes plan dinner, then see fresh vegetables at the store and think, "Let's make this tonight instead"? Use that, and you'll start enjoying the unplanned moments.

INFP>ESTJ.title: Brisk at work, relaxing alone at home.
INFP>ESTJ.body: At work you give clear, quick instructions, and at home you sink into your favorite music or books alone. Your temperament and type differ in all four, so you can use a wide range of strengths depending on the scene. Both the time spent getting things done and the quiet time alone matter to you.
INFP>ESTJ.say: "That's it for today! Everyone getting enough rest?"
INFP>ESTJ.do: On moving day, you tell everyone what order to carry things in, and hand out juice to whoever looks tired.
INFP>ESTJ.worry: The more people rely on you to lead, the more your own feelings come last. On days you were strict, you keep replaying the moment after you get home.
INFP>ESTJ.karai: The one who said "Be there on time" has been waiting since 15 minutes early.
INFP>ESTJ.aru: In meetings you keep things moving: "Please have this done by this date." But on the train home you tear up at a video and think, "Was I a little strict today?"
INFP>ESTJ.why: Your temperament and type are different in all four. By nature you recharge alone, imagine what doesn't exist yet, decide with your feelings, and follow your mood. Along the way you learned to bring people together, decide with facts and logic, and keep to the plan. That's why you move briskly by day and rest your feelings alone at night.
INFP>ESTJ.yure: All four are different, so your whole result can change with the scene. Decide first whether you're picturing yourself in a meeting or watching a movie alone on your day off, and your answers will settle down.
INFP>ESTJ.plus: You wonder if you were too strict because you notice how people feel. Someone who keeps things on track and understands people is a huge help on any team.
INFP>ESTJ.tip: On days you're running things, take one minute at the end to tell each person, "This part really helped." It lifts their mood, and yours too.
INFP>ESTJ.hidden: You organize people smoothly, but you were also born good at imagining what doesn't exist yet. While making slides, don't you sometimes think, "If I show it this way, it'll land better"? Use that, and you can be a leader who also talks about what you want to do.

INFP>ESFJ.title: Someone who likes doing things for others.
INFP>ESFJ.body: You plan the welcome party at work carefully and even get a small gift for each new person. Deciding with people's feelings in mind has never changed for you. You love doing things for others, but you also need time alone to zone out.
INFP>ESFJ.say: "I already booked the place! The rest is a surprise."
INFP>ESFJ.do: For a friend's housewarming, you go through several shops to pick something that fits their room.
INFP>ESFJ.worry: The more you try to meet everyone's expectations, the less time you get to zone out alone. Going along with everyone, you start to feel that wanting your own things is selfish.
INFP>ESFJ.karai: Even with a drama's villain, you think, "Maybe they have their reasons."
INFP>ESFJ.aru: At get-togethers with friends, you plan the seats and food and even set up a surprise. After everyone leaves, you sit on the couch and zone out for a while.
INFP>ESFJ.why: Deciding with people's feelings in mind is the same in your temperament and your type. Three things are different. By nature you recharge alone, imagine what doesn't exist yet, and follow your mood. Along the way you learned to move around people, look at the facts in front of you, and prepare carefully. So time alone zoning out isn't selfish. It's how you recharge.
INFP>ESFJ.yure: Three of the four are different, so your result can change each time. Picture yourself doing things for others or picture yourself daydreaming alone, and a different type may come up.
INFP>ESFJ.plus: You worry about being selfish because you care about the people around you. The ideas that make people happy come from your time alone zoning out.
INFP>ESFJ.tip: Keep the day after a get-together free of plans. Resting alone clears your tiredness, so you can enjoy getting ready for the next one too.
INFP>ESFJ.hidden: You like to prepare well, but you were also born able to move freely in the moment. On a day things didn't go as planned, haven't you laughed and said, "Okay, let's do this instead"? Use that, and you'll feel it's fine even if your prep isn't perfect.

INFP>ISTP.title: You quietly make things with your hands.
INFP>ISTP.body: You fix up an old piece of furniture yourself and paint it your favorite color while you're at it. Loving time alone and moving freely with the moment has never changed for you. You're better at showing feelings with your hands than with words.
INFP>ISTP.say: "No plans today. Might go out if I feel like it."
INFP>ISTP.do: On your day off, you head out for a walk alone without picking a place.
INFP>ISTP.worry: You're not good at putting feelings into words, so your kindness can look curt. Even when logic says it's fine, your hands stop if your heart isn't on board.
INFP>ISTP.karai: Once you start a game alone, you can't stop, and suddenly it's the middle of the night.
INFP>ISTP.aru: You quietly fixed a friend's bike, but when they say "Thanks," all you can say is "No big deal." You're actually really happy.
INFP>ISTP.why: Spending quiet time alone and going with the moment is the same in your temperament and your type. Two things are different. By nature you imagine what doesn't exist yet and decide with your feelings. Along the way you learned to look at what's in front of you and work with your hands, and to think with logic. You do care about people, but you're better at showing it with your hands, so the words come later.
INFP>ISTP.yure: The two differences are hunches or facts, and logic or feelings. Picture yourself making something or picture yourself lost in a work you love, and your result can change.
INFP>ISTP.plus: You say "No big deal" because you care so much it's embarrassing. Your quiet help really does reach people.
INFP>ISTP.tip: When words are hard, just add "But I'm glad" after "No big deal." On days the words won't come, a smile and a nod still get it across.
INFP>ISTP.hidden: You're good at working with what's in front of you, but you were born good at imagining what doesn't exist yet. While gazing outside, don't stories or pictures sometimes spread out in your head? Use that, and you can make something that's all your own.

INFP>ISFP.title: When the sky looks pretty, you can't help taking a photo.
INFP>ISFP.body: You keep stones and leaves you picked up on trips lined up in a little box. Valuing time alone, deciding with your feelings, and going with the flow has never changed for you. You love enjoying the colors and sounds around you, and you love imagining things that don't exist yet.
INFP>ISFP.say: "I kind of like this shop. Can we pop in for a sec?"
INFP>ISFP.do: On a nice day, you change your plans and relax on a park bench.
INFP>ISFP.worry: You have so many things you love, but you don't know how to connect them to your future. You don't like clashing with people, so you tend to swallow what you want to say.
INFP>ISFP.karai: "I love them all, I can't choose," you say, and buy the same top in two colors.
INFP>ISFP.aru: Your phone is full of photos of the sky and flowers. Every time you look back, you remember "I felt like this that day," and you can't delete any of them.
INFP>ISFP.why: Valuing time alone, deciding with your feelings, and moving freely is the same in your temperament and your type. Only one thing is different. By nature you imagine what doesn't exist yet and what things mean, and along the way you learned to enjoy the colors and textures right in front of you. That's why you find so many memories in small things.
INFP>ISFP.yure: The only difference is hunches or facts and experience. Picture your everyday life and you lean toward experience. Picture your future dreams and you lean toward hunches.
INFP>ISFP.plus: You notice flowers by the road because you can find "this is nice" in everyday life. That's something you can use in any job or any life.
INFP>ISFP.tip: Pick your three favorite photos from all you've taken and line them up. You'll see the colors and moods they share, and it'll be easier to say what you like.
INFP>ISFP.hidden: You're good at enjoying everyday life, but you were also born good at imagining what's ahead. Don't you sometimes wonder, "Where would I like to be living in five years?" Use that, and you'll start to see how to connect what you love to your future.

INFP>ESTP.title: When a friend is unsure, you're the one saying "Let's go!"
INFP>ESTP.body: On a trip, you walk right into shops that aren't in the guidebook: "Let's check it out." But later you wonder, "Did everyone have fun?" Going with the moment has never changed for you. You're on the move a lot when you're out, but quiet time alone to think matters too.
INFP>ESTP.say: "Let's just go and figure it out there. It'll probably work out."
INFP>ESTP.do: When you go clothes shopping, you end up trying on a color you never wear.
INFP>ESTP.worry: After acting on impulse, you're alone thinking, "Did anyone feel bad?" People see you as up for anything, so it's hard to say when you want a quiet day.
INFP>ESTP.karai: "Just a quick trip to the convenience store" takes 30 minutes.
INFP>ESTP.aru: You talk a friend into their first bouldering session, "It'll be fun!", and you're the one who gets hooked. On the train home your friend is quiet, and you start to wonder, "Did I push them into it?"
INFP>ESTP.why: Going with the moment is the same in your temperament and your type. Three things are different. By nature you recharge alone, imagine what doesn't exist yet, and decide with your feelings. Along the way you learned to get energy from people, look at the facts in front of you, and move quickly with logic. That's why, after you charge ahead, you think about how the other person feels.
INFP>ESTP.yure: Three of the four are different, so your result can change a lot. Take it after a day out and about, or after a day thinking alone, and a different type may come up.
INFP>ESTP.plus: You worry you pushed too hard because you really wanted your friend to have fun. Someone with the nerve to invite and the care to check in is fun to be around.
INFP>ESTP.tip: When you invite someone, add, "Feel free to head home if you get tired." You'll worry less afterward. On days you want quiet, just say up front, "Today's a slow day for me."
INFP>ESTP.hidden: You can move with real energy, but you were also born good at thinking about what things mean. After a movie, don't you sometimes think hard about "What was this story really trying to say?" Use that, and your words will stay with people.

INFP>ESFP.title: You're as happy about a friend's good news as if it were yours.
INFP>ESFP.body: When you find a great restaurant or a fun place, you tell your friends right away. Caring about people's feelings and going with the flow has never changed for you. People see you as cheerful, but you need quiet time alone too.
INFP>ESFP.say: "I think you'll all love this place! Let's come together next time."
INFP>ESFP.do: When a friend recommends a song, you listen that same day and send them your thoughts.
INFP>ESFP.worry: You pack in so many fun plans that you run out of time alone. You want to keep the mood bright, so you can't let people see when you're sad.
INFP>ESFP.karai: Even when a friend brags about something small, you say "Amazing!" louder than they do.
INFP>ESFP.aru: Around friends you're always bright, and they say "You're so fun to be with." But on the train home, you listen to sad songs and get quietly emotional on your own.
INFP>ESFP.why: Deciding with people's feelings in mind and going with the flow is the same in your temperament and your type. Two things are different. By nature you recharge alone and imagine what things mean. Along the way you learned to get energy from people and enjoy the moment to the fullest. That's why, after a lively time, you want some quiet time alone.
INFP>ESFP.yure: The two differences are whether people energize you or you recharge alone, and hunches or facts. Picture yourself goofing around with friends or picture yourself lost in thought alone, and your result can change.
INFP>ESFP.plus: You need quiet, emotional time because you really feel both the happy and the sad. That's why your cheerfulness puts people at ease.
INFP>ESFP.tip: Put half a day alone between your fun plans. On a sad day, send just one close friend a message: "I'm a bit down today."
INFP>ESFP.hidden: You're great at enjoying the moment, but you were also born good at imagining what's ahead. Don't you sometimes get excited with friends about "Someday let's all do this"? Turn that talk into a real plan, and you'll be the one leading the group.
